text:
Noah: quick follow-up from this morning: several tenant CP attaches in eu-central-1 failed during onboarding surge. looks like CreateNetworkInterface throttling + a few instance ENI limit hits. want to capture short-term guardrails and a long-term plan (pre-warm vs privatelink vs regional relay).

Lina: can you paste the error?

Noah: cloudtrail shows ThrottlingException on CreateNetworkInterface and a handful of ClientError: maximum network interfaces reached. snippet: 
```
2025-02-02T08:12:03Z ERROR create-eni acct=67890 error=ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded
2025-02-02T08:12:04Z ERROR attach acct=67890 error=ClientError: The maximum number of network interfaces for instance i-07d... has been reached
```

Chris: we've discussed before. immediate mitigations: 1) add a regional API rate limiter for CreateNetworkInterface, 2) make attach idempotent + retry only on retryable codes, 3) fallback route via regional relay if attach keeps failing.

Lina: +1. I'd add a warm ENI pool per AZ as fast mitigation. keep pool small (2-4) and a reclaim TTL (10m). that buys time without huge IP waste.

Noah: concerns about IP exhaustion in small subnets. preflight should check remaining IPs before pre-warming. Lina, can you add that to the onboarding preflight?

Lina: yes. will add DescribeSubnets for availableIpAddressCount and enforce pool size <= availableIPs-3.

ops-bot: alert: cp.attach.createNetworkInterface ThrottlingException > 3/min in eu-central-1 at 2025-02-02T08:12. Ticket CP-ENI-2025 created.

Chris: longer-term tradeoffs: Privatelink pushes interface endpoints into customer accounts (reduces our ENI ops) but requires customers to create endpoints and has a per-account endpoint quota; peering + relays simplifies auth but scales poorly with many customers; ENI trunking helps per-instance limits but increases cost/instance complexity.

Noah: proposition: ship warm-pool + region limiter in next sprint, add attach error metrics, and run a Privatelink spike with 2 opt-in customers. if warm pool solves 90% of spikes then hold off on peering work.

Lina: I'll implement preflight + warm-pool GC. Chris can own limiter + metrics. Noah will coordinate Privatelink spike.

Noah: thanks. will update runbook to mark degraded tenants when fallback is used (message: "degraded: using regional relay due to ENI attach issues"). sync Friday for rollouts. :thumbsup:
